proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ A B m n hA
  exact Finset.pluennecke_ruzsa_inequality_nsmul_sub_nsmul_add hA B m n
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [AddCommGroup G] [DecidableEq G] (A B : Finset G) (m n : ℕ), A.Nonempty → (((Finset.image₂ (· - ·) (@nsmulRec (Finset G) ⟨{0}⟩ ⟨Finset.image₂ (· + ·)⟩ m B) (@nsmulRec (Finset G) ⟨{0}⟩ ⟨Finset.image₂ (· + ·)⟩ n B)).card : ℚ≥0)) ≤ ((Finset.image₂ (· + ·) A B).card / A.card : ℚ≥0) ^ (m + n) * A.card
